svg.title: GPTune: fine-tuning GPT-2 774M on one 16 GB GPU
svg.desc: The data pipeline, the 774M model with the tensors trained by the 16 GB preset, the training and sampling loop, the released checkpoints, and the inside of block h25 where the truncation boundary falls.
svg.text: FINE-TUNE GPT-2 774M ON ONE 16 GB GPU
The preset trains the last 128 of the 432 block tensors, so the cut falls inside this block.
